text: In the spectral-radius sweep plots, the vertical line marking the theoretical echo-state-property boundary is drawn at rho = ___.
explanation: rho = 1 is the ESP / edge-of-stability boundary: below it the linearized reservoir contracts (ESP holds), above it the origin is unstable and the ESP is generally lost. The sweep code draws a dashed vertical line at rho = 1, and empirically NMSE starts degrading just before it.
